item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs rgyud las dbal mo las kyi thig le'i gzhung
item.coloph: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi rgyud las/ dbal mo srog gi thig le zhes bya ba/ brnag pa las kyi sbyor ba rdzogs so/ dbal gshen stag la me 'bar gyis thugs bcud/ rgyal gshen mi lus bsam legs kyi man ngag gsungs pa'o/ gdung rabs rim par brgyud nas/ bla chen po dran pa nam mkha'i (mkhas) phyi rabs kyi don du/ stang dmu tsha gyer med dang / rje lha sgom dang / blon mu thur dang*/ ra sangs khod ram dang bzhi la gtad do/ gshen po de bzhis byang phyogs gsang ba'i brag la bsgrubs pa bsnyems so/ phyis su stang dmu tsa gyer med kyis/ phyi rabs las ldan gyi gshen dbra btsun nam mkha' rin chen la brgyad nas gtan la phab bo//
